mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_date, due_date, return_date, status, renew_count, fine_amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowDate}, #{dueDate}, #{returnDate}, #{status}, #{renewCount}, #{fineAmount})
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET user_id = #{userId}, book_id = #{bookId}, borrow_date = #{borrowDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, return_date = #{returnDate}, status = #{status}, renew_count = #{renewCount}, fine_amount = #{fineAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
